title: Parallax card with occlusion

reference.source: external preferred (UI motion capture); synthetic acceptable if labelled
reference.description: A rounded card with three depth layers (background shape, mid object, foreground badge) sliding horizontally at different rates. The mid object passes behind the foreground badge and is partly hidden for about 1 s per loop.

held_tracks: evaluator declares tracks for the mid object and the foreground badge; the mid-object track must show reduced visible area during occlusion

graders.pass: exit code 0 and no check with outcome "fail"
every gated appearance.* check in compare/candidate/report.json has outcome "pass"
every gated temporal.* check passes for every grader-held track (same report as appearance)
exit code 0; at least 2 declared controls render visibly distinct variants; multi-instance host renders every instance
zero major findings (at most three findings recorded)
graders.focus: relative layer rates, correct stacking during occlusion, no layer popping at the seam

graders.check: transcript shows the video-to-css skill was invoked
transcript shows the author ran v2css compare or v2css check on its own scene
